source_name: Richmond Circuit Court Clerk Secure Remote Access (SRA) to land records
verification_note: URL in results for 'Richmond Virginia circuit court deeds secure remote access land records'.
cost: $50/month per individual user, 6-month subscription paid in advance; clerk must approve application
terms_notes: Registered subscribers only; per-user credential (sharing prohibited by SRA rules under Va. Code 17.1-294). Not a bulk feed — no bulk index export offered.
difficulty_reason: Paywalled subscription with clerk approval; no bulk/API access.
notes: Deeds back to 1782 (north of James River) / 1874 (south of river). Also free 'Deed Search' info page: https://www.rva.gov/office-circuit-court-clerk/deed-search (search-confirmed). Free VADeed Alert fraud-notification service for owners. Transfer taxes (statewide): state recordation tax $0.25 per $100 of consideration/value (Va. Code 58.1-801 chapter); city/county may add 1/3 of state tax; grantor tax $0.50 per $500 ($0.10/$100) under 58.1-802, split state/locality. No Northern-Virginia regional add-on applies in Richmond.
